4.desc: When the wearer becomes the target of another ally target's ability, gains 1 stack of "Help," stacking up to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> time(s). If there are <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Help" when the wearer uses their Ultimate, consumes all "Help" to increase the wearer's ATK by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
